payload.text: The tap's CI on 434d105, now on the tap's main (hv pushed it at vc's word on 2026-11-16, decision 9; hold 14 released): run 43922068740 (https://github.com/matthewsinclair/homebrew-ccusage/actions/runs/43922068740), brew style, brew audit --strict, install, test and --version on macos-15 and ubuntu-22.04. dc reports each runner's result with the run's URL to vc's inbox and live.
